model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of several language models across different evaluation datasets. The fifth line, colored purple and marked with an asterisk, represents “StrmLLM(n=380)”, starting at 70.89% at “ARC-c” and ending at 52.50% at “r.KV(%)”.
